Ui.Script:
-- Fork deviation requested for local-world administration. Every widget uses stock -- 1.12 templates/art. The Rust interface is an untrusted-input boundary, never a GM chat command. local actions = { { "item", "Items / Bags", "Grant Item", "Search the validated Classic item catalog by name or item ID, including all bag sizes. Granting an item does not imply every use or equip effect is supported.", "Count (1-200)", "1" }, { "gold", "Gold", "Grant Gold", "Classic money: 1 gold = 10,000 copper. The authority checks the character's balance and commits the grant atomically.", "Gold (1-10,000)", "1" }, { "mount", "Mounts", "Grant Mount", "Choose a supported mount from this world's catalog. This grants the real supported mount; it does not swap the character's appearance.", nil, "" }, { "speed", "Movement Speed", "Set Speed", "Movement changes require the world's authoritative movement and acknowledgement path. 100% restores the normal admin speed setting.", "Speed % (100-300)", "100" }, { "teleport", "City Teleport", "Teleport", "Choose a major city supported by this world. The authority validates its map, destination and current session before moving the character.", nil, "" }, { "level", "Level +1", "Gain +1 Level", "Instantly gain exactly one level, up to this world's supported Classic maximum. The authority applies the full level-up state changes.", nil, "" }, { "xp", "XP Gain", "", "On: receive XP normally. Off: keep current XP and level, but receive no further XP from any source. The setting must persist with the character.", nil, "" }, { "reputation", "Reputation", "Adjust Reputation", "Choose a supported faction. Positive points increase reputation; negative points decrease it. The authority validates faction rules and limits.", "Points (-42,999 to +42,999; nonzero)", "100" }, { "honor", "Honor Points", "Grant Honor", "Classic honor contribution is tracked by day and week. Honorable kills and PvP rank are separate. Requires a durable, authorized honor backend.", "Contribution points (1-100,000)", "1" }, { "time", "Time of Day", "Set World Time", "Set the world clock for all participants, in 24-hour time. Enter auto to return to the automatic world clock. This is not a local lighting override.", "HH:MM (00:00-23:59), or auto", "12:00" }, { "weather", "Weather", "Set Weather", "Choose a validated weather option for your current location, including Automatic to restore normal weather. The world authority rechecks location and applies it consistently.", nil, "" }, } local catalogActions = { item = 1, mount = 1, teleport = 1, reputation = 1, weather = 1 } local selected, filtered, entryIndex = 1, {}, 1 local currentView, lastEntries, lastQuery, lastAction
local function setEnabled(button, enabled) if enabled then button:Enable() else button:Disable() end end
function BenillaAdmin_Select(index) selected = index entryIndex = 1 BenillaAdminFrameSearch:SetText("") BenillaAdminFrameAmount:SetText(actions[index][6]) BenillaAdminFrameSearch:ClearFocus() BenillaAdminFrameAmount:ClearFocus() BenillaAdmin_Refresh() end
function BenillaAdmin_Cycle(direction) if table.getn(filtered) > 0 then entryIndex = math.mod(entryIndex - 1 + direction + table.getn(filtered), table.getn(filtered)) + 1 end BenillaAdmin_Refresh() end
function BenillaAdmin_Refresh() if not BenillaAdminFrameApply then return end local spec = actions[selected] currentView = BenillaAdminGetView and BenillaAdminGetView() or { identity = "No verified world admin", status = "Admin gameplay backend unavailable in this session.", message = "", } local capability = currentView[spec[1]] or { enabled = false, reason = "Admin gameplay backend unavailable in this session.", entries = {}, } BenillaAdminFrameIdentity:SetText(currentView.identity) BenillaAdminFrameContext:SetText(currentView.status) BenillaAdminFrameOperationTitle:SetText(spec[2]) BenillaAdminFrameHelp:SetText(spec[4]) BenillaAdminFrameReason:SetText(capability.reason ~= "" and capability.reason or "Available to the verified world admin") BenillaAdminFrameResult:SetText(currentView.message) for i = 1, table.getn(actions) do getglobal("BenillaAdminAction" .. i):SetButtonState(i == selected and "PUSHED" or "NORMAL", i == selected) end local catalog = catalogActions[spec[1]] for _, widget in ipairs({ BenillaAdminFrameSearch, BenillaAdminFrameSearchLabel, BenillaAdminFrameChoice, BenillaAdminFramePrevious, BenillaAdminFrameNext }) do if catalog then widget:Show() else widget:Hide() end end local query = string.lower(BenillaAdminFrameSearch:GetText()) if lastEntries ~= capability.entries or lastQuery ~= query or lastAction ~= selected then filtered = {} entryIndex = 1 for _, entry in ipairs(capability.entries) do if query == "" or string.find(string.lower(entry.label), query, 1, 1) or entry.id == query then table.insert(filtered, entry) end end lastEntries, lastQuery, lastAction = capability.entries, query, selected end if entryIndex > table.getn(filtered) then entryIndex = 1 end local entry = filtered[entryIndex] BenillaAdminFrameChoice:SetText(entry and (entry.label .. " [" .. entry.id .. "]\n" .. entryIndex .. " / " .. table.getn(filtered)) or "No supported catalog matches") setEnabled(BenillaAdminFramePrevious, table.getn(filtered) > 1) setEnabled(BenillaAdminFrameNext, table.getn(filtered) > 1) if spec[5] then BenillaAdminFrameAmountLabel:SetText(spec[5]) BenillaAdminFrameAmountLabel:Show() BenillaAdminFrameAmount:Show() else BenillaAdminFrameAmountLabel:Hide() BenillaAdminFrameAmount:Hide() end local label = spec[3] if spec[1] == "xp" then if currentView.xp_enabled == nil then label = "XP Control Unavailable" elseif currentView.xp_enabled then label = "Turn XP Gain Off" else label = "Turn XP Gain On" end elseif spec[1] == "level" and currentView.current_level then label = "Gain +1 Level (" .. currentView.current_level .. "/" .. currentView.max_level .. ")" end BenillaAdminFrameApply:SetText(label) setEnabled(BenillaAdminFrameApply, capability.enabled and (not catalog or entry)) end
function BenillaAdmin_Apply() local spec = actions[selected] local capability = currentView and currentView[spec[1]] if not capability or not capability.enabled or not BenillaAdminSubmit then BenillaAdmin_Refresh() return end local entry = filtered[entryIndex] local amount = BenillaAdminFrameAmount:GetText() if spec[1] == "xp" then amount = currentView.xp_enabled and "off" or "on" end BenillaAdminSubmit(spec[1], entry and entry.id or "", amount) BenillaAdminFrameAmount:ClearFocus() BenillaAdmin_Refresh() end
function BenillaAdmin_OnLoad() UIPanelWindows["BenillaAdminFrame"] = { area = "center", pushable = 0, whileDead = 1 } for index, spec in ipairs(actions) do local row = CreateFrame("Button", "BenillaAdminAction" .. index, this, "UIPanelButtonTemplate") row:SetWidth(134) row:SetHeight(22) row:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", this, "TOPLEFT", 20, -77 - (index - 1) * 27) row:SetText(spec[2]) row:SetID(index) row:SetScript("OnClick", function() BenillaAdmin_Select(this:GetID()) end) end end

Scripts.OnShow: local scale = math.min(1, GetScreenWidth() / 604, GetScreenHeight() / 548) this:SetScale(scale) BenillaAdmin_Select(1) if UpdateMicroButtons then UpdateMicroButtons() end PlaySound("igMainMenuOpen")
Scripts.OnUpdate: this.adminElapsed = (this.adminElapsed or 0) + arg1 if this.adminElapsed >= 0.25 then this.adminElapsed = 0; BenillaAdmin_Refresh() end
Scripts.OnHide: BenillaAdminFrameSearch:ClearFocus(); BenillaAdminFrameAmount:ClearFocus(); if UpdateMicroButtons then UpdateMicroButtons() end; PlaySound("igMainMenuClose")

Ui.Script:
-- ══ The frame: the era layout, 28+144+28 wide, 32 top, 28 bottom, 8 rungs of 21 and -- three gaps of 20 ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ GameMenuFrame:SetWidth(200) GameMenuFrame:SetHeight(288)
-- The stock title (`GameMenuFrame.xml:36`) has no name: found as addons find it. for _, region in ipairs({ GameMenuFrame:GetRegions() }) do if region:GetObjectType() == "FontString" and region:GetText() == MAIN_MENU then region:SetFontObject(BenillaGameFontNormalMed1) end end
-- BENILLA_ERA_WINDOW_SCALE (OptionsFrame.xml) stands in for the era's UIParent scale; -- read at every show, then the stock OnShow. local Ref_GameMenuFrame_OnShow = GameMenuFrame:GetScript("OnShow") GameMenuFrame:SetScript("OnShow", function() this:SetScale(BENILLA_ERA_WINDOW_SCALE or 1) Ref_GameMenuFrame_OnShow() end)
-- ══ The rungs ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -- Every stock rung stays, anchored TOP to a BOTTOM as in the stock file, so an addon's -- `SetPoint("TOP", …)` replaces its one anchor. The three the era menu lacks are hidden -- in place, with Sound and UI Options each laid over the rung above it, so they take no -- space: a width or height of 0 is no size in 1.12's layout, not a flat rect.
-- Literal: 1.12 has no GAMEMENU_OPTIONS; its OPTIONS_MENU is "Options Menu". GameMenuButtonOptions:SetText("Options") GameMenuButtonOptions:ClearAllPoints() GameMenuButtonOptions:SetPoint("TOP", GameMenuFrame, "TOP", 0, -32) GameMenuButtonOptions:SetScript("OnClick", function() PlaySound("igMainMenuOption") HideUIPanel(GameMenuFrame) ShowUIPanel(BenillaOptionsFrame) end)
for _, fold in ipairs({ { GameMenuButtonSoundOptions, GameMenuButtonOptions }, { GameMenuButtonUIOptions, GameMenuButtonSoundOptions }, }) do local button, above = fold[1], fold[2] button:Hide() button:ClearAllPoints() button:SetPoint("TOP", above, "BOTTOM", 0, button:GetHeight()) end -- Key Bindings keeps its stock anchor, 1 under UI Options: the era rungs hang from its -- top, so an addon that inserts a button above it and re-anchors it under that button -- (ShaguTweaks) moves them down as it moves the stock rungs. GameMenuButtonKeybindings:Hide()
-- Fork-only Admin rung, using the same stock button template as the game menu. local admin = CreateFrame("Button", "BenillaGameMenuButtonAdmin", GameMenuFrame, "GameMenuButtonTemplate") admin:SetPoint("TOP", GameMenuButtonKeybindings, "TOP", 0, -19) admin:SetText("Admin") admin:SetScript("OnClick", function() PlaySound("igMainMenuOption") HideUIPanel(GameMenuFrame) ShowUIPanel(BenillaAdminFrame) end)
-- The era's Edit Mode and Support, with nothing behind them yet: disabled. local editMode = CreateFrame("Button", "BenillaGameMenuButtonEditMode", GameMenuFrame, "GameMenuButtonTemplate") editMode:SetPoint("TOP", admin, "BOTTOM", 0, 0) editMode:SetText("Edit Mode") editMode:Disable() local support = CreateFrame("Button", "BenillaGameMenuButtonSupport", GameMenuFrame, "GameMenuButtonTemplate") support:SetPoint("TOP", editMode, "BOTTOM", 0, 0) support:SetText("Support") support:Disable()
GameMenuButtonMacros:SetPoint("TOP", support, "BOTTOM", 0, 0) GameMenuButtonLogout:SetPoint("TOP", GameMenuButtonMacros, "BOTTOM", 0, -20) GameMenuButtonQuit:SetPoint("TOP", GameMenuButtonLogout, "BOTTOM", 0, 0) GameMenuButtonContinue:SetPoint("TOP", GameMenuButtonQuit, "BOTTOM", 0, -20)
-- ══ Our options window in the stock "is an options window open?" checks ═══════════════ -- Each wraps the stock function to add `BenillaOptionsFrame`. local Ref_IsOptionFrameOpen = IsOptionFrameOpen local Ref_ToggleGameMenu = ToggleGameMenu local Ref_UpdateMicroButtons = UpdateMicroButtons
-- Guarded for a test kit that loads the game menu without the options window. local function BenillaOptions_IsOpen() return BenillaOptionsFrame and BenillaOptionsFrame:IsVisible() end
-- `UIParent.lua:996`: a yes keeps the ESC sweep off the centre panel, which our window is. function IsOptionFrameOpen() if BenillaAdminFrame:IsVisible() then return 1 end if BenillaOptions_IsOpen() then return 1 end return Ref_IsOptionFrameOpen() end
-- `UIParent.lua:1465-1497`: static popup, then an open options window, then the stock -- ladder. Our Close click is the discard-and-hide of the reference's `OptionsFrameCancel`. function ToggleGameMenu(clicked) if clicked then if BenillaAdminFrame:IsVisible() then HideUIPanel(BenillaAdminFrame) end -- As the reference's `clicked` arm: close an options window, then toggle. if BenillaOptions_IsOpen() then BenillaOptionsFrameCloseButton:Click() end return Ref_ToggleGameMenu(clicked) end if StaticPopup_EscapePressed() then return end if BenillaAdminFrame:IsVisible() then HideUIPanel(BenillaAdminFrame) return end if BenillaOptions_IsOpen() then BenillaOptionsFrameCloseButton:Click() return end return Ref_ToggleGameMenu(clicked) end
-- `MainMenuBarMicroButtons.lua:47-58`: only ever pushes the button, so the stock decision -- stands and ours adds our window. Guarded for a test kit that loads no micro buttons. function UpdateMicroButtons() if Ref_UpdateMicroButtons then Ref_UpdateMicroButtons() end if MainMenuMicroButton and (BenillaOptions_IsOpen() or BenillaAdminFrame:IsVisible()) then MainMenuMicroButton:SetButtonState("PUSHED", 1) end end
